shipping.title: Shipping and Delivery Policy
body: This Shipping and Delivery Policy explains how BGS Corner General Trading L.L.C ("we," "us," or "our") processes, ships, and delivers orders placed through https://bgscorner.com (the "Website").
This policy forms part of our Terms and Conditions. By placing an order on the Website, you agree to the terms set out in this policy.
## 1. Scope of This Policy

This policy applies to all orders placed through the Website for delivery within the United Arab Emirates. We currently do not ship to addresses outside the UAE. If we expand our delivery areas in the future, this policy will be updated accordingly.
## 2. Delivery Areas

We currently deliver only within the United Arab Emirates. We do not serve customers outside the UAE at this time. We reserve the right to expand our delivery areas in the future as part of our business expansion plans. Any such expansion will be announced on the Website and reflected in an updated version of this policy.
## 3. Order Processing Time
All orders are subject to a processing period before dispatch. Our standard order processing time is 1 to 3 business days (Saturday to Thursday, excluding public holidays in the UAE).
Orders placed on Fridays or during UAE public holidays will be processed on the next business day.
Once your order has been processed, you will receive a dispatch confirmation email with tracking details, where available.
## 4. Delivery Timeframes
Estimated delivery timeframes after dispatch are as follows:
- ​ Dubai and surrounding areas: 1 to 2 business days.
- ​ Other Emirates (Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain): 2 to 4 business days.
- ​ Remote or rural areas within the UAE: 3 to 7 business days.
These timeframes are estimates only and are not guaranteed. Actual delivery times may vary depending on your location, courier capacity, weather conditions, or other factors beyond our control.
## 5. Shipping Costs
Shipping costs, if any, will be clearly displayed at checkout before you complete your purchase. No additional shipping or logistics fees will be imposed after checkout.
From time to time, we may offer free shipping promotions. The terms of any such promotion will be displayed on the Website.
## 6. Payment Methods
We accept the following payment methods:
- ​ Credit and Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard).
- ​ Secure online payment gateways.
We do not offer Cash on Delivery.
We are not currently registered for Value Added Tax (VAT) and therefore do not charge VAT on any orders. No VAT will be added at checkout or on delivery.
## 7. Order Tracking

Where available, we will provide you with a tracking number and a link to track your order once it has been dispatched. You can also contact us at info@bgscorner.com or +971 58 929 7556 for updates on your order status.
Please allow up to 24 hours for tracking information to become active after you receive your dispatch confirmation.
## 8. Failed Delivery Attempts
If our courier is unable to deliver your order because no one is available to receive it, or because the delivery address provided is incorrect or inaccessible, the courier may:
- ​ Attempt delivery again on another business day; or
- ​ Return the order to us.

If the order is returned to us due to a failed delivery attempt, we will contact you to arrange redelivery. Additional shipping charges may apply for redelivery. If you choose not to have the order redelivered, we will refund the product price minus any original shipping costs and any return shipping costs incurred by us.
## 9. Delivery Address Accuracy
You are responsible for providing a complete and accurate delivery address at checkout. Please include:
- ​ Building name or number.
- ​ Street name.
- ​ Area or district.
- ​ Emirate.
- ​ Any additional landmarks or delivery instructions.

We are not responsible for delays or failed deliveries caused by incorrect or incomplete address information provided by you. If a delivery fails due to an incorrect address, additional charges may apply for redelivery.
## 10. Risk and Title
Risk of loss or damage to the products passes to you upon delivery. Title to the products passes to you upon full payment being received by us.
If you receive a product that is damaged in transit, please contact us immediately at info@bgscorner.com or +971 58 929 7556, and we will assist you in accordance with our Returns and Refund Policy.
## 11. Delivery Delays
We are not liable for any delay or failure to deliver caused by events beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to:
- ​ Extreme weather conditions.
- ​ Natural disasters.
- ​ Strikes or labour disputes.
- ​ Courier service disruptions.
- ​ Government actions, customs delays, or regulatory restrictions.
- ​ Pandemics or public health emergencies. If such an event occurs, we will contact you as soon as reasonably possible to inform you of the delay and to arrange a new delivery date.
## 12. International Shipping
We currently do not offer international shipping. All orders must be delivered to an address within the United Arab Emirates.

If we begin offering international shipping in the future, this policy will be updated to include applicable terms, including any customs duties, taxes, or import fees that may apply. Any such charges will be the responsibility of the customer unless otherwise stated.
## 13. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Shipping and Delivery Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our operations, courier partners, legal requirements, or business practices. We will post the updated version on this page and update the "Last Updated" date at the top.

Where changes are material, we will provide reasonable notice on the Website or by email before the changes take effect. Your continued use of the Website after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
## 14. Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Shipping and Delivery Policy, please contact us:
BGS Corner General Trading L.L.C​ 418, GEWAN, Jewel of The Creek,​ Porta Saeed, Deira, Dubai, UAE​ Phone: +971 58 929 7556​ Email: info@bgscorner.com​ Website: https://bgscorner.com

returns.title: Returns and Refund Policy
body: At BGS Corner General Trading L.L.C ("we," "us," or "our"), we want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. This Returns and Refund Policy explains your rights and our obligations regarding returns, refunds, and exchanges for products purchased from https://bgscorner.com (the "Website").

This policy is governed by UAE Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection and its implementing regulations. Nothing in this policy limits or excludes your statutory rights as a consumer under UAE law.
By placing an order on the Website, you agree to the terms of this Returns and Refund Policy.
## 1. Scope of This Policy

This policy applies to all products purchased through the Website for delivery within the United Arab Emirates. We currently do not serve customers outside the UAE. If we expand our delivery areas in the future, this policy will be updated accordingly.
This policy does not apply to:
- ​ Products that are custom-made or personalized to your specifications.
- ​ Products that are clearly marked as non-returnable or final sale at the time of purchase.
- ​ Products that have been used, damaged, or altered after delivery.
- ​ Digital products or services, where applicable.
## 2. Your Right to Cancel Before Dispatch

You may cancel your order at any time before it has been dispatched by contacting us at info@bgscorner.com or +971 58 929 7556. If your order has not yet been dispatched, we will cancel it and issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Once an order has been dispatched, it cannot be cancelled. Instead, you may return the product in accordance with the return procedures set out below.
## 3. Return Window
You have the right to return most products within 14 calendar days from the date of delivery. This 14-day period is provided in addition to your statutory rights under UAE consumer protection law.

For products that are defective, damaged, or not as described, you may have a longer period to return them in accordance with your statutory rights. Please contact us as soon as you discover any issue.
## 4. Conditions for Return
To be eligible for a return, the product must meet the following conditions:
- ​ The product must be unused, undamaged, and in the same condition that you received it.
- ​ The product must be returned in its original packaging, including all accessories, manuals, and tags.
- ​ You must provide proof of purchase, such as your order confirmation email or receipt.
- ​ The product must not be a non-returnable item as described in Section 1.
We reserve the right to refuse a return if the product does not meet these conditions. If we refuse a return, we will explain our reasons and may return the product to you at your cost.
## 5. How to Initiate a Return
To initiate a return, please follow these steps:

1.​ Contact us at info@bgscorner.com or +971 58 929 7556 within the applicable return window. 2.​ Provide your order number, the product you wish to return, and the reason for the return. 3.​ Our customer service team will review your request and provide you with return instructions, including the return address. 4.​ Pack the product securely in its original packaging. 5.​ Ship the product to the address provided by our customer service team. Please do not send any product back to us without first contacting us and receiving return instructions. Returns sent without prior authorization may be refused.
## 6. Return Shipping Costs

- ​ Defective, damaged, or incorrectly sent products: We will bear the cost of return shipping. We will provide you with a prepaid shipping label or reimburse you for reasonable shipping costs upon receipt of the returned product.

- ​ Change of mind or non-defective returns: You are responsible for the cost of return shipping. We recommend using a trackable shipping service, as we are not responsible for returns lost in transit.
Original delivery fees are non-refundable unless the product is defective, damaged, or not as described.
## 7. Refund Process

Once we receive your returned product, we will inspect it to ensure it meets the conditions set out in Section 4. We will notify you of the outcome of our inspection within 5 business days of receiving the product.
If your return is approved, we will process your refund within 14 calendar days of the approval date. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method used for the purchase.
Please note:
- ​ We do not offer Cash on Delivery, so refunds will not be issued in cash.
- ​ We are not registered for Value Added Tax (VAT) and therefore do not charge VAT on any orders. No VAT will be deducted from or added to your refund.
- ​ Depending on your bank or payment provider, it may take additional time for the refund to appear in your account. We are not responsible for any delays caused by your bank or payment provider.
## 8. Exchanges

If you would like to exchange a product for a different item, please contact us at info@bgscorner.com or +971 58 929 7556. Exchanges are subject to product availability and the conditions set out in Section 4.

If the exchange item is more expensive than the original product, you will be required to pay the difference. If the exchange item is less expensive, we will refund the difference to your original payment method.
## 9. Defective, Damaged, or Incorrect Products

If you receive a product that is defective, damaged, or not as described, please contact us immediately at info@bgscorner.com or +971 58 929 7556. We will arrange for a replacement, repair, or full refund in accordance with your statutory rights under UAE consumer protection law.
Please provide photos or videos of the defect or damage, along with your order number, to help us resolve the issue quickly.
## 10. Non-Returnable Items
The following items are not eligible for return unless they are defective, damaged, or not as described:
- ​ Perishable goods, including food and beverages.
- ​ Personal care items, including cosmetics and hygiene products, if opened or used.
- ​ Custom-made or personalized products.
- ​ Products marked as final sale or non-returnable at the time of purchase.
- ​ Gift cards or vouchers.
## 11. Statutory Rights

Nothing in this Returns and Refund Policy excludes, restricts, or modifies any statutory rights you may have under UAE Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection or any other applicable law in the United Arab Emirates.
If there is any conflict between this policy and your statutory rights, your statutory rights will prevail.
## 12. Complaints and Dispute Resolution
We are committed to resolving consumer complaints fairly and promptly. If you have a complaint about a return or refund, please contact us:
- ​ Email: info@bgscorner.com

We will acknowledge your complaint within 2 business days and aim to resolve it within 14 business days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may escalate the matter to the relevant UAE consumer protection authority.
## 13. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Returns and Refund Policy from time to time to reflect changes in law, regulation, or our business practices. We will post the updated version on this page and update the "Last Updated" date at the top.

Where changes are material, we will provide reasonable notice on the Website or by email before the changes take effect. Your continued use of the Website after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
## 14. Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Returns and Refund Policy, please contact us:
BGS Corner General Trading L.L.C​ 418, GEWAN, Jewel of The Creek,​ Porta Saeed, Deira, Dubai, UAE​ Phone: +971 58 929 7556​ Email: info@bgscorner.com​ Website: https://bgscorner.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: This Privacy Policy explains how BGS Corner General Trading L.L.C ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, discloses, and protects your personal data when you visit or make a purchase from https://bgscorner.com (the "Website"). We are committed to protecting your privacy and complying with the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and other applicable laws in the United Arab Emirates. By using the Website, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
## 1. Who We Are

The data controller responsible for your personal data is: BGS Corner General Trading L.L.C​ 418, GEWAN, Jewel of The Creek,​ Porta Saeed, Deira, Dubai, UAE​ Phone: +971 58 929 7556​ Email: info@bgscorner.com​ Website: https://bgscorner.com If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us using the details above.
## 2. Personal Data We Collect
We may collect and process the following categories of personal data:
- ​ Identity Data: First name, last name, and title.
- ​ Contact Data: Billing address, delivery address, email address, and phone number.
- ​ Transaction Data: Details about payments you make and products you purchase from us.

- ​ Technical Data: Internet Protocol (IP) address, browser type and version, time zone setting, browser plug-in types and versions, operating system and platform, and other technology on the devices you use to access the Website.
- ​ Usage Data: Information about how you use the Website, products, and services.

- ​ Marketing and Communications Data: Your preferences in receiving marketing from us and your communication preferences. We do not collect any Special Categories of Personal Data (such as race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, health data, or biometric data). We do not store your credit or debit card details. All payment transactions are processed by secure third-party payment gateways.
## 3. How We Collect Your Personal Data
We collect personal data through the following methods:
- ​ Direct Interactions: You provide data when you create an account, place an order, subscribe to our newsletter, contact us by phone, email, or through the Website, or provide feedback.

- ​ Automated Technologies: As you interact with the Website, we may automatically collect Technical Data about your equipment, browsing actions, and patterns. We collect this data using cookies, server logs, and similar technologies.
- ​ Third Parties: We may receive personal data about you from various third parties, including analytics providers, advertising networks, and payment service providers.
## 4. How We Use Your Personal Data
We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we use your personal data for the following purposes:
- ​ To process and fulfill your order, including managing payments, fees, and charges.
- ​ To deliver products to your specified address within the United Arab Emirates.
- ​ To manage our relationship with you, including notifying you about changes to our Terms and Conditions or Privacy Policy.
- ​ To administer and protect our business and the Website, including troubleshooting, data analysis, testing, and system maintenance.
- ​ To improve our Website, products, services, marketing, and customer relationships.

- ​ To send you marketing communications where you have opted in or where we have a legitimate interest to do so, subject to your right to opt out at any time. We do not use your personal data for automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal effects concerning you.
## 5. Legal Basis for Processing
Under the UAE PDPL, we rely on the following legal bases to process your personal data:
- ​ Consent: Where you have given us clear consent to process your data for a specific purpose, such as receiving marketing communications.
- ​ Contractual Necessity: Where processing is necessary for the performance of a contract with you, such as fulfilling your order.
- ​ Legal Obligation: Where processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation to which we are subject.
- ​ Legitimate Interests: Where processing is necessary for our legitimate interests or those of a third party, provided your interests and fundamental rights do not override those interests.
## 6. Disclosure of Your Personal Data
We may share your personal data with the following categories of recipients:

- ​ Service Providers: Third-party companies that provide services to us, including payment processors, delivery and logistics partners, IT and system administration providers, and marketing service providers.
- ​ Professional Advisers: Accountants, auditors, lawyers, and insurers who provide professional services to us.
- ​ Government and Regulatory Authorities: Where we are required to disclose your data by law, regulation, or court order.

- ​ Business Transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or part of our business, your data may be transferred to the acquiring entity. We require all third parties to respect the security of your personal data and to treat it in accordance with the law. We do not allow our third-party service providers to use your personal data for their own purposes and only permit them to process your personal data for specified purposes and in accordance with our instructions.
## 7. International Transfers

We are based in the United Arab Emirates and currently serve customers only within the UAE. Your personal data is primarily stored and processed within the UAE. If we expand our operations to serve customers outside the UAE in the future, we will update this Privacy Policy and take appropriate safeguards to ensure that your personal data receives an adequate level of protection in accordance with the PDPL.
## 8. Data Security

We have implemented appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data from accidental loss, unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include:
- ​ Encryption of sensitive data transmitted through the Website.
- ​ Secure servers and firewalls.
- ​ Regular security reviews and updates.

- ​ Restricted access to personal data to authorized personnel only. While we strive to protect your personal data, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.
## 9. Data Retention

We will retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which we collected it, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, accounting, or reporting requirements. To determine the appropriate retention period, we consider the amount, nature, and sensitivity of the data, the potential risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure, the purposes for which we process your data, and applicable legal requirements. In some circumstances, we may anonymize your personal data so that it can no longer be associated with you, in which case we may use such information without further notice to you.
## 10. Your Rights
Under the UAE PDPL, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
- ​ Right to Access: You have the right to request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
- ​ Right to Correction: You have the right to request that we correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
- ​ Right to Deletion: You have the right to request that we delete your personal data, subject to certain legal exceptions.
- ​ Right to Restrict Processing: You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances.
- ​ Right to Object: You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data where we are relying on a legitimate interest.
- ​ Right to Data Portability: You have the right to request that we transfer your personal data to another controller, where technically feasible.

- ​ Right to Withdraw Consent: Where we rely on your consent to process your personal data, you have the right to withdraw that consent at any time. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@bgscorner.com. We will respond to your request within 30 days. We may need to request specific information from you to help us confirm your identity and ensure your right to access your personal data. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the UAE Data Office or the relevant supervisory authority if you believe your data protection rights have been violated.

## 11. Cookies and Similar Technologies Our Website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to distinguish you from other users, improve your browsing experience, and analyze how the Website is used.

You can set your browser to refuse all or some browser cookies, or to alert you when websites set or access cookies. If you disable or refuse cookies, please note that some parts of the Website may become inaccessible or not function properly. We will obtain your consent before placing non-essential cookies on your device, in accordance with applicable law.
## 12. Children's Privacy

Our Website is not intended for children under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us at info@bgscorner.com, and we will take steps to delete such information.
## 13. Third-Party Links

The Website may include links to third-party websites, plug-ins, and applications. Clicking on those links or enabling those connections may allow third parties to collect or share data about you. We do not control these third-party websites and are not responsible for their privacy statements. We encourage you to read the privacy policy of every website you visit.
## 14. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. We will post the updated version on this page and update the "Last Updated" date at the top. Where changes are material, we will provide reasonable notice on the Website or by email before the changes take effect. Your continued use of the Website after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the revised Privacy Policy.
## 15. Contact Us If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data protection practices, please contact us:
BGS Corner General Trading L.L.C​ 418, GEWAN, Jewel of The Creek,​ Porta Saeed, Deira, Dubai, UAE​ Phone: +971 58 929 7556​ Email: info@bgscorner.com​ Website: https://bgscorner.com
